intro: Forged Steel Bars are refined metal ingots belonging to the orc blacksmith Thun'grim Firegaze. Stolen by opportunistic Razormane quilboar during a night raid, they serve as proof of a warrior's resolve to recover stolen property in the Barrens.

p: Forged Steel Bars represent high-quality smithing stock belonging to the visually impaired orc smith Thun'grim Firegaze, who maintains a camp in the northern Barrens. Taking advantage of Thun'grim's failing eyesight, local Razormane quilboar distracted the smith with grunts and snorts while thieves slipped away with an iron chest containing the ingots. Unskilled in metalcrafting fine steel, the quilboar abandoned the unopened container near a ruined wagon in their encampment to the northwest, leaving the bars intact for recovering warriors to reclaim.
